scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on restricting access to 3D-printed firearms by prohibiting the online distribution of digital instructions for their creation. This directly aims to implement stricter gun rules by controlling a new method of firearm production.

The bill aims to prevent criminals, including felons and domestic abusers, from obtaining untraceable firearms through 3D printing, and references the use of untraceable guns in crimes. By prohibiting the distribution of 3D printer plans for firearms, it seeks to strengthen law enforcement's ability to trace firearms and prevent gun crimes, thus contributing to stricter justice and stronger policing.
